name: Tail Strike (Combat)
body:
You have strengthened your tail enough to make slap attacks with it.

Prerequisite(s): Lizardfolk level 1st.

Benefit(s): You gain a tail slap attack. This is a secondary attack that deals 1d4 points of bludgeoning damage plus 1/2 your Strength modifier.
